summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the half year ended 30 June 2026, including income statement, balance sheet, and equity changes. The filing reports routine financial results and capital transactions such as ordinary dividends, paid-in equity issuance, and share repurchases. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, spin-off, or strategic review is disclosed. The share repurchases appear to be ordinary-course capital returns, not a formal capital return program. This is a routine earnings disclosure, so it does not constitute a special situation.
